name: BL-041 chart-pattern POC: detectors, tests and pass/kill thresholds
source: backlog/BL-041-chart-pattern-poc.md - the plan; this file is the machine-readable copy of its rules
rule: Committed before any BL-041 detection, event study or backtest. Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason. Detector thresholds are frozen in bl041_criteria_addendum_1.json after the gallery check and before Phase 4.
owner_approved: 2026-10-07, in the session that wrote the plan ('Yes I am good. Continue')

universe.bars: bars_1d_stock daily OHLCV; highs/lows/opens back-adjusted by chaining NSE prevclose (factor = prevclose_d / close_{d-1}); every pattern measure is a ratio inside its window

windows.plain: Nothing before Phase 6 reads a bar dated 2024-01-01 or later, and no forward return in Phases 4-5 ends after 2023-12-29.

states.forming: the pattern's rules hold at this Friday's close
states.near_pivot: forming, and the close is within 5% below the pivot
states.broke_out: a close above the pivot on volume at least 1.5x the 50-day average, within the last 2 weeks (this Friday included), with the base still valid on the breakout day

detectors_starting_values.note: Starting values only. Phase 3 tunes them on the owner's gallery labels (never on returns); the frozen values go in addendum 1.

tight_range.pivot: highest high of the tightest qualifying window

cup_handle.pivots: causal zigzag on weekly closes, reversal 8%; a swing point exists only from the week that confirmed it

phase_2_momentum_during_formation.asked_by: owner, 2026-10-07: bases take 10-30+ weeks; does the momentum rank fall while they form?
report: For every detection: the stock's momentum rank (global and pool) at base start, at the base midpoint and at the detection Friday
Share of detections whose stock is inside the pool top 10 / 20 / 40 / 200 at the detection Friday
Detections per year, per pattern and per state
phase_2_momentum_during_formation.plain: Shows whether pattern stocks are still high-momentum names when the pattern completes - i.e. whether the filter and bonus shapes can even reach them. Not a gate.

phase_3_gallery.tuning_input: owner labels only, never forward returns

phase_4_event_study.sample: stock-weeks in the Broad pool (stock_pool_ranks not NaN), development window
phase_4_event_study.event: detected (any state); per-state results reported, not judged
phase_4_event_study.return: the adjusted weekly close the engine trades (ranking.prices), Friday t to Friday t+h
phase_4_event_study.control: same Friday, same pool-rank decile, no detection of that pattern
phase_4_event_study.weekly_statistic: sum over deciles of n_event_d * (mean_event_d - mean_control_d) / sum n_event_d
phase_4_event_study.test: one-sided t on the weekly statistic series with Newey-West standard errors, lags = horizon
phase_4_event_study.multiple_testing: Holm across 3 patterns x 3 horizons, alpha 0.05
phase_4_event_study.pass: the 13-week test survives Holm and its mean is positive

phase_5_ranking_test.hook: the pattern shape re-ranks UniverseRanking.stock_pool_ranks; run_broad_backtest runs unchanged on that ranking (category_mode off)

blend.score: (1-w) * momentum_pct + w * pattern_score, momentum_pct = 1 - (pool_rank-1)/(N-1); re-ranked, ties by pool rank

filter.how: detected names with pool rank <= top_n first (in momentum order), then every other pool name in momentum order

bonus.how: detected names move up B ranks; re-ranked, ties by pool rank

walk_forward.pick: for each year, per pattern, the shape with the highest sum of weekly log excess return over the baseline from 2012-01-06 to 13 weeks before 1 January of that year
walk_forward.hold: that shape through the calendar year; years joined

pbo.on: weekly log excess return over the baseline, 21 trials, development window

phase_5_ranking_test.pass: joined walk-forward excess CAGR over the baseline > 0, AND PBO <= 0.3
phase_5_ranking_test.holdout_choice: per passing pattern, the shape with the highest development-window excess log return over the baseline

phase_6_holdout.enters: a pattern that passed Phase 3, Phase 4 and Phase 5
reported: the four bl010_phase6_frozen.json configs with the chosen shape applied to combined_pool_ranks

will_not_run: any detection, event study or backtest that reads 2024-01-01 or later before Phase 6
any detector threshold chosen by forward returns
shapes or weights outside the 21 trials above
